stemMd: What is the principal point of the passage?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A rise in reports after an intervention can have several explanations that require separate investigation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Brighter lamps necessarily prevent all vandalism.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Residents should never contact the council.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Complaint registers contain only false reports.

explanationMd: The analyst separates actual damage, detection and reporting. The same observed increase can arise through different mechanisms, so a causal conclusion needs more targeted evidence.

distractorRationale.e: Better detection can produce accurate additional reports.
distractorRationale.b: The analyst explicitly avoids assuming harmlessness.
